summary: The RADIUS-over-TLS experiment in RFC 6614 opened RADIUS to new uses where the old 4096-octet packet size limit is a problem. This experimental document extends the RADIUS-over-TCP experiment from RFC 6613 to permit larger RADIUS packets. It complements other work on allowing bigger packets.

eli5.summary: Imagine a mail slot that only fits small envelopes, but now you need to send bigger ones. This widens the slot so the network login system can pass along bigger messages in one go.
